updates.title: Market Update
updates.content: The stock market showed resilience this week, with the S&P 500 attempting to break to a new high despite low volume and a lack of conviction among investors.

updates.title: Current Developments
updates.content: Key macro events this week included the release of PCE data, which came in as expected, and a drop in personal spending, which is in line with the consumer pulling back. Additionally, oil prices reached a 3-month high driven by seasonal demand and supply issues.

updates.title: Market Reactions
updates.content: Markets reacted cautiously to the PCE data and personal spending numbers, with a lack of conviction among investors reflected in low volume. Meanwhile, the energy sector benefited from rising oil prices.

updates.title: Portfolio Strategy
updates.content: A diversified long-term investor should consider hedging against potential market volatility by adding a dividend/value ETF and a technology sector ETF to their portfolio, in addition to a broad S&P 500 index fund.

updates.title: Looking Ahead
updates.content: Next week, investors should watch for the impact of the presidential debate on market sentiment and potential changes in the portfolios of long-term investors.
